description.value: You've begun to develop your personal legend about nuar history, tailored from your own study and interests. While not necessarily factual, the legend is captivating when you tell it. You can use any Lore skill in which you're trained to [[/act make-an-impression]] or [[/act create-a-diversion]], instead of using Diplomacy and Deception respectively. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your Diplomacy checks using Lore if the target isn't interested in or trained in the same or a related Lore skill (creatures are trained in the skills listed in their stat blocks).
